profile_text.body:
Ouster, Inc. is a public company headquartered in San Francisco, California, trading under the ticker OUST, with SEC CIK 0001816581. Its website describes digital lidar sensors aimed at autonomy in vehicles, robotics, drones, automation, and smart cities.

The site also cites a partnership with Komatsu. Matt Reiland, Technical Director, Automation Innovation at Komatsu, is quoted saying that products developed through the partnership can withstand shock, vibration and temperature constraints while delivering the range and spatial awareness needed to operate in harsh mining environments.

The litigation exposure on record for the company is in California, with a count of 281. No lawsuits are listed against it in the record.
